title: Research: prove the fixed T16 buffer transport cut
body:
## Summary

```diff
 exact PR3388, fixed final chronology
- remaining16/32-buffer consolidation by neutral transport is open
+ neutral equal-capacity whole-bin transport, then one full48 split, is impossible
+ every candidate full48 bundle supplies at most 9 eligible width;16 is required
```

The first-visit lemma bounds arbitrarily long neutral transport histories, including repeated visits and whole evacuation of partially occupied bins. The relaxed rank16-buffer closure has 896 locations and four eligibility classes. Family conflicts are ignored and the rank32 buffer is granted unrestricted placement, so those constraints cannot rescue this strategy.

This is a scoped negative result on exact PR3388 `684d347c0e6e578b8ab600d2e680ad6701cf7fa0`. Nonneutral or partial-bin rearrangements and chronology changes remain open. No packing optimum, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3388 explicitly asks whether its remaining empty16 and32 buffers can support48 consolidation. **After:** the source-bound closure adds 858 bins, then 37, then none. All 2,288 original full48 bundles offer maximum eligible widths `{0:2185,4:12,9:91}`, below 16.
- All 20 retained source files match the exact public source head byte-for-byte. The primary reconstructs and owner-audits all sixteen PR3388 stages, then compares all 69,120 final roles and the complete final plan with the fixtures. A separate checker imports no project code and independently reconstructs the actual source-event windows and closure using explicit sets.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, eight behavioral groups, all 576 tiny transport systems, five actual CLI rejections, optimized controls, Ruff diagnostics and formatting pass. Committed-byte/source-history checks pass for all 76 required files. A fresh committed Git-free export passes the primary, independent and behavioral checks with all 77 exported files unchanged, including the transport manifest.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-buffer-transport-cut
```

Proof, exact sources, full replay and limits are in `research/t16-buffer-transport-cut/`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3355#discussioncomment-19008660). Credit Pierre/hexapode for PR3388 and its retained source chain, Hao Yan for the controller and independent owner audit, Philippe Van Velzen for admission, and the predecessor compiler/owner/bit/geometry/moment contributors preserved in the source documents.

Concurrent PR3390 at `dd9c46f721864683144e76605c143795b61f06eb` reports a different fixed-chronology augmentation with delta `3H1-25H3+8H6+3H8`. It is outside this intact-bundle16/32-to48 strategy and is not independently replayed here. This proof does not claim the latest packing frontier is blocked.

No new owner map is produced. Strict physical admission, supplier/outer repricing, selected cold replay, formal-kernel and independent human review are not claimed. Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

One isolated proof package with authenticated retained sources. Frozen inputs, selected records and shared checkers are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research
